tagline: Global leader in energy infrastructure, gas and steam turbines, and grid technologies
hero_kpi_rationale: Record orders of €17.6 billion in Q1 FY26 reflect strong market momentum driven by increased demand across all regions for gas turbines, gas services, and electrical grid technologies.
company_description: Siemens Energy AG operates as an energy technology company worldwide. It operates through Gas Services, Grid Technologies, Transformation of Industry, and Siemens Gamesa segments. The company provides gas and steam turbines, generators, and heat pumps, as well as performance enhancement, maintenance, digitalization, and consulting services for central and distributed power generation; and high voltage direct current transmission systems, offshore wind farm grid connections, transformers, flexible alternating current transmission systems, high voltage substations, air and gas-insulated switchgears, circuit breakers, capacitor, digital grid solutions and components, components and cyber security, and transformers and storage solutions. kpis.name: Total Orders
kpis.explanation: Total orders received in Q1 FY26 across all business segments, demonstrating strong market demand.
kpis.description: Siemens Energy Group's total orders reached a record €17.6 billion in Q1 FY26, up 34% on a comparable basis from €13.7 billion in Q1 FY25, reflecting broad-based growth across all business segments and geographic regions.
kpis.signal: Record orders of €17.6bn in Q1 FY26, up 34% comparable (excluding currency translation and portfolio effects) from €13.7bn in Q1 FY25, driven by strong demand in Americas (+59%), EMEA (+18%), and Asia & Australia (+23%).

kpis.name: Revenue
kpis.explanation: Total revenue generated in Q1 FY26 from all business segments.
kpis.description: Group revenue reached €9.7 billion in Q1 FY26, up 13% on a comparable basis from €8.9 billion in Q1 FY25, including €3.3 billion from service activities.
kpis.signal: Revenue of €9.7bn in Q1 FY26, up 13% comparable from €8.9bn in Q1 FY25, with service revenue contributing €3.3bn in both periods.

kpis.name: Free Cash Flow
kpis.explanation: Free cash flow pre-tax generation demonstrating strong cash conversion and liquidity position.
kpis.description: Pre-tax free cash flow reached €2.9 billion in Q1 FY26, up 93% from €1.5 billion in Q1 FY25, supported by advance payments and favorable working capital developments (increase in contract liabilities of €2.5 billion).
kpis.signal: Exceptional free cash flow of €2.9bn pre-tax in Q1 FY26, up 93% from €1.5bn in Q1 FY25, driven by strong order momentum and advance payments creating favorable working capital timing effects.

kpis.name: Profit Margin Before Special Items
kpis.explanation: Profit margin before special items showing operational profitability improvement.
kpis.description: Profit margin before special items improved to 12.0% in Q1 FY26, compared to 5.4% in Q1 FY25, representing a 680 basis point expansion, reflecting significant improvement in operational profitability and positive timing effects.
kpis.signal: Profit before special items improved to €1,159m in Q1 FY26 (12.0% margin) from €481m in Q1 FY25 (5.4% margin), representing 680 basis points margin expansion driven by volume leverage and positive timing effects.

kpis.name: Order Backlog
kpis.explanation: Total order backlog providing visibility into future revenue generation with increasing margin profile.
kpis.description: The order backlog reached a record €146 billion in Q1 FY26, up 30% since FY23, providing exceptional visibility into future revenue generation with an improving margin profile as high-margin orders are progressively converted.
kpis.signal: Record order backlog of €146bn as of Q1 FY26, up 30% from €112bn in FY23, with approximately 90% expected to convert to revenue in FY26-FY27 and 30% thereafter.

kpis.name: Book-to-Bill Ratio
kpis.explanation: Ratio of orders to revenue indicating demand strength and forward-looking revenue visibility.
kpis.description: The book-to-bill ratio improved to 1.82x in Q1 FY26, compared to 1.53x in Q1 FY25, reflecting a 19% increase and demonstrating strong market demand and excellent future revenue visibility.
kpis.signal: Book-to-bill ratio improved to 1.82x in Q1 FY26 from 1.53x in Q1 FY25, demonstrating strong demand momentum and increasing order intake relative to revenue generation.

kpis.name: Gas Services Order Intake
kpis.explanation: Highest quarterly order intake in Gas Services history driven by exceptional demand for gas turbines.
kpis.description: Gas Services recorded the highest quarterly order volume in its history with 102 gas turbines ordered in Q1 FY26, representing 13 GW of installed capacity and 80 GW of total commitments, including 22 GW related to data centers.
kpis.signal: Highest quarterly order intake in history with 102 gas turbines booked in Q1 FY26, representing 13 GW of capacity with 80 GW total commitments, of which 22 GW data center related.

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of €56.64bn in the latest year

kpis.description: Siemens Energy is executing a $1 billion investment plan to scale up grid and gas turbine equipment production across multiple U.S. locations including Mississippi, North Carolina, Florida, Alabama, Texas, and New York to support strong U.S. market growth and the energy transition.

Two major capacity expansion projects completed: (1) Wind Power Transformer factory in Austria with €100m investment, 25,000 m² capacity for 2,000 transformers/year and 450 employees; (2) Transformer Tanks manufacturing facility in Zagreb with ~160 custom tanks/year and >400 employees, following KONČAR and Siemens Energy JV Agreement.
Siemens Gamesa demonstrated Q1 profitability on track to reach sustained break-even status, with improvements benefitting from positive timing effects and portfolio optimization efforts.
Both S&P and Moody's upgraded Siemens Energy's investment grade credit ratings, reflecting improved financial resilience and the company's strong order backlog and profitability trajectory.
